name: EDigital Accessibility Tools and Statement
author: edigital2026

sections.description:
EDigital Accessibility Tools and Statement is a comprehensive accessibility plugin that helps WordPress sites work towards compliance with Israeli Amendment 13 to the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law, and the Israeli accessibility standard IS 5568, which is based on WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines.

🇮🇱 בעברית: תוסף נגישות והצהרת נגישות בחינם לאתרי וורדפרס. עמידה בתיקון 13 לחוק שוויון זכויות לאנשים עם מוגבלות. כולל ווידג’ט נגישות מתקדם ומחולל הצהרת נגישות אוטומטי. נגישות חינם לאתר שלך.

Accessibility Widget

A floating accessibility button with a full toolbar of adjustments:

  • Text size — increase or decrease in steps
  • Contrast modes — high contrast / dark mode / light mode / inverted colors
  • Color filters — grayscale / sepia
  • Cursor size — large dark cursor / large light cursor
  • Highlight links — visually emphasize all links on the page
  • Dyslexia-friendly font — switches body text to the Lexend typeface
  • Stop animations — pauses CSS animations and transitions
  • Reading guide — a highlighted strip that follows the mouse to assist reading
  • Line height — adjustable line spacing
  • Word spacing — adjustable spacing between words
  • Preference memory — all selections are stored locally in the visitor’s browser (localStorage), with no data sent to any server

Accessibility Statement

  • Automatically generates a dedicated Accessibility Statement page
  • Includes the sections commonly expected for Amendment 13 disclosures
  • A [edgaa_accessibility_statement] shortcode that can be embedded on any page
  • Organization details, last review date, and conformance level are configurable and update the statement automatically

Admin Settings Panel

  • Hebrew-language (RTL) settings interface in wp-admin
  • Choice of widget position (4 corners)
  • Custom widget color via a color picker
  • Each feature can be individually toggled on or off

Privacy

  • No third-party servers are used to store visitor data
  • No cookies are set; visitor preferences are stored only in the browser’s localStorage
  • Designed with GDPR and Israeli privacy regulation considerations in mind

Developed by Elimelech Digital, a digital marketing and accessibility consultancy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/edigital-accessibility-tools-statement directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings page in the wp-admin main menu.
  4. Enter your organization details and click Save Settings.
  5. Click “Create Accessibility Statement Page” to generate the statement automatically.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin guarantee full compliance with Amendment 13?

The plugin provides meaningful tools to improve accessibility, but full compliance with Amendment 13 also requires adjustments to the site’s underlying code (image alt text, correct heading structure, built-in color contrast, etc.). We recommend a full accessibility audit in addition to installing this plugin.

Can I change the widget’s position and/or color?

Yes. Position (4 corners) and a custom color can be set directly from the settings panel.

Can I remove the “Elimelech Digital” credit from the accessibility statement?

Yes. The credit shown on the accessibility statement page can be turned off from the Branding tab in the plugin settings. Note that the credit shown inside the floating accessibility widget itself always remains visible, and helps support continued free development of the plugin.

Does the plugin store visitor data?

No. Visitor preferences are stored only in their browser’s localStorage, are never transmitted to a server, and are not collected in any way.

What is the minimum required PHP version?

PHP 7.4 or higher.
